summary: Feedback, Background Job, and Full-Text Search
description:
Implement the feedback draft/submit lifecycle scoped to sessions. Deliver the timeline and cross-round feedback rollup endpoints. Build the background job service that auto-transitions sessions from SCHEDULED to IN_REVIEW, with PostgreSQL advisory locking, Micrometer metrics, and Kafka event publication. Add the Kafka consumer for notifications.send dispatching via AWS SES. Implement full-text question search using PostgreSQL tsvector and auto-generate OpenAPI docs.

Key paths: <apps/api/src/main/java/com/ims/feedback>, <services/background-job/src/main/java/com/ims/job>
functionality: submit structured feedback after conducting a session and have the platform automatically progress sessions and notify stakeholders
benefit: closes the full interview lifecycle loop — feedback reaches admins and marketers, and background automation removes manual status management overhead

stories.summary: Implement feedback draft and submit lifecycle
stories.description:
Implement the Feedback module with draft create/update and a one-way submit action. Once submitted, feedback is locked and cannot be edited. Supporters can only access their own feedback; admins can read all submitted feedback for a session.

Endpoints: POST /sessions/:id/feedback (create draft), PATCH /sessions/:id/feedback (update draft), POST /sessions/:id/feedback/submit (submit and lock).

Key paths: <apps/api/src/main/java/com/ims/feedback/FeedbackService.java>, <apps/api/src/main/java/com/ims/feedback/FeedbackController.java>

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Supporter creates a feedback draft
acceptanceCriteria.given: an authenticated supporter is assigned to a session
acceptanceCriteria.when: POST /sessions/:id/feedback is called with feedback content
acceptanceCriteria.then: a feedback record is created in DRAFT status and a 201 response is returned

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Submitted feedback cannot be edited
acceptanceCriteria.given: a feedback record has been submitted via POST /sessions/:id/feedback/submit
acceptanceCriteria.then: a 409 Conflict response is returned and the feedback remains unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Admin can read all submitted feedback for a session
acceptanceCriteria.given: multiple supporters have submitted feedback for a session
acceptanceCriteria.then: all submitted feedback records for that session are returned

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Supporter cannot read another supporter's feedback
acceptanceCriteria.given: a supporter calls GET /sessions/:id/feedback
acceptanceCriteria.then: only feedback authored by that supporter is returned

tasks.summary: Implement FeedbackEntity, repository, and service
tasks.description: Create JPA entity mapping to the feedback table with status field (DRAFT/SUBMITTED). Implement FeedbackService with create, update (draft only), and submit methods. Submit sets submitted_at and locks the record.

tasks.summary: Implement FeedbackController with role-scoped access
tasks.description: Expose feedback CRUD and submit endpoints. Enforce: supporters access own feedback only, admins access all submitted feedback per session.

tasks.summary: Add integration tests for feedback lifecycle
tasks.description: Cover: create draft, update draft, submit, attempt to edit submitted (expect 409), admin read all, supporter read own only.

stories.summary: Implement process timeline and cross-round feedback rollup endpoints
stories.description:
Implement GET /processes/:id/timeline returning a chronological rollup of all sessions, their statuses, status history events, and feedback submission indicators for a given process. Implement GET /processes/:id/feedback returning all submitted feedback across all rounds of the process, visible to admin and marketer only.

Key paths: <apps/api/src/main/java/com/ims/process/TimelineService.java>

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Timeline returns all sessions with status history
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process has 3 sessions with various statuses and status history events
acceptanceCriteria.then: a response is returned with each session and its full status history ordered chronologically

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Feedback rollup returns all submitted feedback across rounds
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process has feedback submitted in rounds 1 and 2
acceptanceCriteria.then: all submitted feedback records are returned grouped by session/round

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Candidate cannot access timeline with feedback details
acceptanceCriteria.given: a candidate calls GET /processes/:id/feedback
acceptanceCriteria.then: a 403 Forbidden response is returned

tasks.summary: Implement TimelineService with session and status history aggregation
tasks.description: Query sessions and their STATUS_HISTORY rows for a process. Map to a TimelineResponse DTO with sessions ordered by round and events ordered by changed_at.

tasks.summary: Implement cross-round feedback rollup query and endpoint
tasks.description: Join sessions → feedback for a process, filtering to SUBMITTED feedback only. Expose as GET /processes/:id/feedback restricted to admin and marketer.

tasks.summary: Add integration tests for timeline and feedback rollup
tasks.description: Cover: multi-round process timeline ordering, feedback rollup completeness, candidate 403 on feedback endpoint.

stories.summary: Build background job service with advisory lock, Kafka publication, and Micrometer metrics
stories.description:
Build the background job as a separate Spring Boot service under <services/background-job>. On an hourly @Scheduled trigger, acquire a PostgreSQL advisory lock to prevent concurrent execution, query sessions where status=SCHEDULED and scheduled_at < now(), transition each to IN_REVIEW, write STATUS_HISTORY with change_source=BACKGROUND_JOB, and publish events to both session.status.changed and notifications.send Kafka topics. Instrument with custom Micrometer metrics.

Custom metrics:
- background.job.executions (counter)
- background.job.sessions.transitioned (counter)
- background.job.duration (timer)

Key paths: <services/background-job/src/main/java/com/ims/job/SessionTransitionJob.java>

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Job transitions overdue sessions to IN_REVIEW
acceptanceCriteria.given: two sessions have status=SCHEDULED and scheduled_at in the past
acceptanceCriteria.then: both sessions are updated to IN_REVIEW, STATUS_HISTORY rows are written with change_source=BACKGROUND_JOB, and events are published to session.status.changed

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Advisory lock prevents concurrent execution
acceptanceCriteria.given: the job is already running and holds the advisory lock
acceptanceCriteria.when: a second instance attempts to run
acceptanceCriteria.then: the second instance fails to acquire the lock and exits without processing any sessions

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Job publishes to notifications.send for each transitioned session
acceptanceCriteria.given: three sessions are transitioned by the job
acceptanceCriteria.then: three messages are published to the notifications.send Kafka topic, one per session

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Custom Micrometer metrics are emitted per run
acceptanceCriteria.given: the job has executed and transitioned 2 sessions
acceptanceCriteria.then: background.job.executions is incremented by 1, background.job.sessions.transitioned is incremented by 2, and background.job.duration records the run time

tasks.summary: Scaffold background-job Spring Boot service
tasks.description: Create Spring Boot project under <services/background-job> with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, spring-kafka, and micrometer-registry-cloudwatch2. Share database connection to the main RDS instance.

tasks.summary: Implement hourly @Scheduled trigger and PostgreSQL advisory lock
tasks.description: Use @Scheduled(cron) for hourly execution. Acquire advisory lock via pg_try_advisory_lock() before processing. Release lock in a finally block. Skip run if lock is not acquired.

tasks.summary: Implement session query, transition, and STATUS_HISTORY write
tasks.description: Query sessions where status=SCHEDULED and scheduled_at < now(). For each, update status to IN_REVIEW and write a STATUS_HISTORY row with change_source=BACKGROUND_JOB.

tasks.summary: Implement Kafka event publication for session.status.changed and notifications.send
tasks.description: After each session is transitioned, publish a SessionStatusChangedEvent to session.status.changed and a NotificationEvent to notifications.send using KafkaTemplate.

tasks.summary: Instrument custom Micrometer metrics
tasks.description: Register background.job.executions Counter, background.job.sessions.transitioned Counter, and background.job.duration Timer. Increment/record on each job execution.

tasks.summary: Add integration tests with Testcontainers Postgres and Kafka
tasks.description: Test: overdue sessions are transitioned, advisory lock blocks concurrent run, Kafka messages are published per session, metrics are incremented correctly.

stories.summary: Implement Kafka notification consumer dispatching via AWS SES
stories.description:
Implement a Kafka consumer in the background-job service subscribing to the notifications.send topic. For each message, determine the notification type and dispatch a templated email via AWS SES to the appropriate recipients. Handle consumer failures by routing to the DLQ (notifications.send.dlq).

Notification types and recipients:
- SESSION_SCHEDULED: candidate and supporter
- SESSION_IN_REVIEW: admin and marketer
- SESSION_OUTCOME: admin and marketer
- FEEDBACK_SUBMITTED: admin

Key paths: <services/background-job/src/main/java/com/ims/job/NotificationConsumer.java>

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: SESSION_SCHEDULED notification dispatches email to candidate and supporter
acceptanceCriteria.given: a SESSION_SCHEDULED event is consumed from notifications.send
acceptanceCriteria.then: an email is sent via AWS SES to both the candidate and the assigned supporter

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Consumer failure routes message to DLQ
acceptanceCriteria.given: the SES API call throws an exception during notification dispatch
acceptanceCriteria.when: the consumer exhausts its retry attempts
acceptanceCriteria.then: the message is routed to notifications.send.dlq and not reprocessed

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Unknown notification type is handled gracefully
acceptanceCriteria.given: a message with an unrecognised notification type is consumed
acceptanceCriteria.then: an error is logged and the message is routed to the DLQ without crashing the consumer

tasks.summary: Implement Kafka consumer for notifications.send
tasks.description: Create a @KafkaListener subscribing to notifications.send with consumer group background-job.notification-sender. Deserialise the NotificationEvent payload.

tasks.summary: Implement AWS SES email dispatch per notification type
tasks.description: Use AWS SDK v2 SesClient. Map each notification type to the correct recipient list and email template. Read sender address and template IDs from environment.

tasks.summary: Configure DLQ routing and retry policy
tasks.description: Configure a SeekToCurrentErrorHandler with a fixed back-off and max retry attempts. Wire a DeadLetterPublishingRecoverer routing failed messages to notifications.send.dlq.

tasks.summary: Add integration test for notification consumer with Testcontainers Kafka
tasks.description: Publish a test notification event to the topic and verify the correct SES call is made (via mock SesClient). Verify DLQ routing on simulated SES failure.

stories.summary: Implement full-text question search with PostgreSQL tsvector
stories.description:
Add full-text search to the question bank using PostgreSQL tsvector and GIN indexing. Expose GET /questions?q=:term supporting full-text search across question text and topic fields. Update the search_vector column via a Flyway migration adding a tsvector generated column and GIN index. Use to_tsquery for query parsing with plainto_tsquery as a safe fallback.

Key paths: <apps/api/src/main/java/com/ims/question/QuestionSearchService.java>, <apps/api/src/main/resources/db/migration>

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Full-text search returns relevant questions
acceptanceCriteria.given: the question bank contains questions with varying topics and text
acceptanceCriteria.then: only questions matching the search terms in their text or topic are returned, ranked by relevance

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Empty search term returns all questions paginated
acceptanceCriteria.given: no q parameter is provided
acceptanceCriteria.then: all non-deleted questions are returned in paginated form

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Malformed search query does not crash the endpoint
acceptanceCriteria.given: a q parameter contains special characters that would break a raw tsquery
acceptanceCriteria.then: plainto_tsquery sanitises the input and a valid response is returned

tasks.summary: Add search_vector tsvector column and GIN index via Flyway migration
tasks.description: Write a Flyway migration adding a generated tsvector column on the questions table combining question_text and topic. Create a GIN index on the column.

tasks.summary: Implement QuestionSearchService with tsvector query
tasks.description: Use a native query with to_tsvector and plainto_tsquery for the search. Apply Spring Data pagination. Fall back to returning all questions when q is absent or blank.

tasks.summary: Expose GET /questions with optional q search parameter
tasks.description: Add search query parameter to the existing QuestionController list endpoint. Route to QuestionSearchService when q is present.

tasks.summary: Add integration tests for full-text search
tasks.description: Use Testcontainers Postgres with real GIN index. Cover: matching results returned, no results for non-matching term, empty q returns all, special character input handled safely.

stories.summary: Auto-generate OpenAPI docs and complete Testcontainers integration test suite
stories.description:
Configure springdoc-openapi to auto-generate an OpenAPI 3.0 spec from all controllers. Annotate controllers and DTOs with OpenAPI annotations for accurate schema and security documentation. Ensure Testcontainers integration tests covering all API endpoints per role are complete and passing as the Phase 3 milestone requirement.

Key paths: <apps/api/src/main/java/com/ims/config/OpenApiConfig.java>

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: OpenAPI spec is accessible at runtime
acceptanceCriteria.given: the application is running
acceptanceCriteria.then: a valid OpenAPI 3.0 JSON document is returned listing all endpoints with request/response schemas

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Swagger UI is available in non-production environments
acceptanceCriteria.given: the application is running in dev or staging profile
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Swagger UI renders all endpoints and allows test invocations with JWT auth

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: All integration tests pass against Testcontainers
acceptanceCriteria.given: the full test suite is run with Testcontainers providing Postgres, Redis, and Kafka
acceptanceCriteria.then: all integration tests pass with no failures

tasks.summary: Add springdoc-openapi dependency and OpenAPI config
tasks.description: Add springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui. Configure @OpenAPIDefinition with title, version, and JWT SecurityScheme. Disable Swagger UI in prod profile.

tasks.summary: Annotate controllers and DTOs with OpenAPI annotations
tasks.description: Add @Operation, @ApiResponse, and @Schema annotations to all controllers and request/response DTOs to produce accurate schema documentation.

tasks.summary: Complete integration test coverage for all Phase 3 endpoints
tasks.description: Audit all endpoints across auth, user, client, process, session, question, and feedback modules. Write any missing integration tests using Spring Boot Test + Testcontainers (Postgres + Redis + Kafka).
